ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.thesis: NVDA appeared in all 6 of 6 overnight screens with universal high conviction — the strongest signal in this digest. The stock has pulled back ~5% in a broad semi selloff to ~$220, compressing into a hard August 26 earnings catalyst where consensus revenue sits at $91.8B–$95B (+67% YoY). At sub-25x forward earnings versus a historical 35–40x range, the stock is at a multi-year valuation low even as 36 of 37 analysts rate it Strong Buy with a ~$302 consensus price target (+34.6% gap). A defined-risk call spread (e.g. Sep $230/$260) is preferred over outright stock given elevated pre-earnings implied volatility and binary outcome risk.
